sourceArtifact.title: Source-first monetary discovery census: PHB and DMG

scope.purpose: A full PDF-page text-screening census plus bounded page/group-level visual discovery for the supplied PHB and DMG scans. It enumerates direct monetary-claim and monetary-table categories found in the visually screened pages beyond already named inventories.
scope.coverageClaim: The PDF page denominator is complete and every PDF page has a screening state. Semantic discovery is not whole-book complete: text-screened noncandidates are not evidence of absence; many candidates remain unreviewed; reduced contact-sheet review does not establish exact wording, row mapping, or table completeness.
scope.sourcePriority: Hash-verified private source PDF scans are authoritative. PyMuPDF text cues and OCR help queue pages but do not establish monetary meaning, wording, or absence.
scope.tablePolicy: New table categories are recorded at group level only. No new table group is row-transcribed in this census.
scope.privacy: Original PDFs, full-page renders, and the supplemental p.175 scan remain private and are not included in the repository artifact.

screeningMethod.tool: PyMuPDF text extraction from every page; source PDF hashes and page counts checked before screening.
screeningMethod.candidateRule: A page is a screened-candidate if one or more configured cue regexes match extracted text. A screened-noncandidate means only that none of these cues matched the extracted text.
limitations: Image-only/empty text layers and OCR omissions can hide claims.
Broad cues intentionally overinclude weight/encumbrance, starting money, XP, treasure-generation quantities, gem descriptions, table-of-contents entries, and non-price uses of cost/value words.
A candidate is not a verified monetary claim.
A noncandidate is not a verified absence.
Contact-sheet thumbnails support only page/group classification; fine print, exact units, conditions and row/value pairings require source-scale review.

scope.purpose: A full PDF-page text-screening census plus bounded page/group-level visual discovery for the supplied PHB and DMG scans. It enumerates direct monetary-claim and monetary-table categories found in the visually screened pages beyond already named inventories.
scope.coverageClaim: The PDF page denominator is complete and every PDF page has a screening state. scope.sourcePriority: Hash-verified private source PDF scans are authoritative. PyMuPDF text cues and OCR help queue pages but do not establish monetary meaning, wording, or absence.
scope.tablePolicy: New table categories are recorded at group level only. No new table group is row-transcribed in this census.
scope.privacy: Original PDFs, full-page renders, and the supplemental p.175 scan remain private and are not included in the repository artifact.

sourceArtifact.title: Source-first monetary inventory: Monster Manual and Monster Manual II

scope.purpose: Candidate inventory of monetary prices, fees, costs, and explicit valuations found during full-page PDF text-layer census followed by visual inspection of selected original pages.
scope.coverageClaim: This is not a claim that every price in either book has been found. Search cues are fallible; unflagged/image-only or OCR-corrupted pages may contain monetary claims. Every page remains represented in the census, and unreviewed candidates stay explicit.
scope.sourcePriority: Original private PDF scan is authoritative. Text-layer/OCR cues locate candidates and do not establish source wording or absence.
scope.privacy: Original PDFs and rendered source pages remain private and are not included in the repository artifact.

screeningMethod.tool: PyMuPDF text extraction from every page of both hash-verified PDFs; page text char count recorded.
screeningMethod.candidateRule: Any page with one or more configured currency, transaction, valuation, or gem cues is a broad text candidate. This deliberately overincludes treasure tables, XP labels, carrying-weight values, and OCR noise.
limitations: Text-layer page census is not visual proof of all page content.
Image-only pages and OCR-corrupted/missed wording may contain unflagged prices.
Unreviewed cue pages are pending visual review; they are not marked as having no price.
The page-cue screen is not exhaustive and does not establish whole-book completeness.

coverageSummary.interpretation: Counts describe this bounded audit and its documented records only; they do not estimate all-book completeness or error rates.

visualReviewMethod.rendering: Full-page raster views rendered locally from the hash-verified private PDFs with PyMuPDF at approximately 1.3–1.4 scale; one Pech passage was additionally inspected in a 3x local detail render.
visualReviewMethod.bounds: OCR text-block bounding boxes in PDF-page points, top-left origin. These bounds are provisional and are not pixel-calibrated; visual confirmation of a value does not upgrade its coordinate bounds.
visualReviewMethod.privateArtifacts: Source PDFs and rendered images remain outside the repository.

scope.purpose: Candidate inventory of monetary prices, fees, costs, and explicit valuations found during full-page PDF text-layer census followed by visual inspection of selected original pages.
scope.coverageClaim: This is not a claim that every price in either book has been found. Search cues are fallible; unflagged/image-only or OCR-corrupted pages may contain monetary claims. Every page remains represented in the census, and unreviewed candidates stay explicit.
scope.sourcePriority: Original private PDF scan is authoritative. Text-layer/OCR cues locate candidates and do not establish source wording or absence.
scope.privacy: Original PDFs and rendered source pages remain private and are not included in the repository artifact.

continuations.scope: Source-bound excerpt segments for reviewed Charging, Abjure, the shared PHB p.33 human two-class example, the shared PHB p.70 Invisibility passage, the UA p.10 elven-subrace passage, and the UA p.59–60 Magic-User Contingency passage. Records distinguish printed-page order from PDF source identity. The twelve p.33 groups preserve the same-page left-to-right opening/continuation for ten core class catalogs, the dual-class rule, and progression explainer. These groups assert source-image passage parts and order only; mechanics, values, owner-specific field support, variant applicability, and precise highlights remain pending. Unlisted continuations remain unassessed. The 38 DMG p.225 encumbrance groups link each complete table row to the same-page right-column exclusion and bulkiness continuation in bottom-left to top-right order; source values and owner-specific mechanics remain separate reviews. The two Drow page10–11 groups preserve primary and legacy crop variants of the same cross-page passage; available context is linked but the original fold/shadow and fact highlights remain unresolved.
